summary.text: Robert Jones is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Tennessee who describes himself as a historian, educator, business owner, archaeologist and nonprofit leader. He says he accepts no campaign donations and has no political party directing his decisions.

paragraphs.text: Jones describes himself as a husband and father and says he holds a Ph.D. in Classics, a master's degree in Military History, an M.B.A., a bachelor's degree in Corporate Finance and a certificate in Strategic Management.
He says he teaches history and has taken part in archaeological research in the United States and abroad.
In business, Jones says he founded his first company at 17 and has helped his wife build and operate veterinary practices. He also says he directs a farm-animal sanctuary.
